# Catalogue

Le catalogue est généré à partir des fichiers `metadata.yml` ou `metadata/dataset.yaml` placés dans chaque dossier de jeu de données.

```{r}
#| label: catalogue-table
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
source("R/utils_card_images.R")

catalogue_path <- "data/metadata/catalogue.csv"

if (file.exists(catalogue_path)) {
  catalogue <- read_csv(catalogue_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ensure_card_images(catalogue)

  cat("::: {.card-grid}\n")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(catalogue))) {
    row <- catalogue[i, ]
    fiche_html <- str_replace(row$fiche, "\\.qmd$", ".html")
    image_path <- card_image_path(row$id)
    image_alt <- paste("Illustration du thème", row$theme)
    image_alt <- str_replace_all(image_alt, "\"", "&quot;")

    cat("::: {.db-card}\n")
    if (!is.na(image_path) && file.exists(image_path)) {
      cat("<img class=\"db-card-image\" src=\"", image_path, "\" alt=\"", image_alt, "\">\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("### [", row$title, "](", fiche_html, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Source : ", row$source_name, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Thème : ", row$theme, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Taille : ", row$n_rows, "; ", row$n_cols, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Type : ", row$data_type, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Niveau : ", row$level, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Score zéro déchet : ", row$zero_waste_score, "/30\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Concepts : ", str_replace_all(row$concepts, "; ", ", "), "\n", sep = "")
    cat(":::\n\n")
  }

  cat(":::\n")
} else {
  cat("Le catalogue n'a pas encore été généré. Exécuter `Rscript scripts/build_catalogue.R`.")
}
```
